chapter: The Artist By the Moon's Side (III)
act_title: The Artist By the Moon's Side (III)

quests.title: The Artist By the Moon's Side (III)

dialogue.t: Huh? Isn't that Maalaus? Has she been out gathering inspiration, again?
Yes. But the little one has been like this ever since she came back... As if lost in thought.
Huh, maybe the theme this time is super profound... Y'know, like when a great artist realizes some fundamental truth about the world.
Come to think of it, Maalaus has given us a whole bunch of paintings. We could hold an entire exhibition at this rate!
Hehe, Paimon can't wait to tell everyone all about our little painter's rise to artistic stardom! Ah, but we'd need Columbina's permission first, of course.
Hm? Why is that?

dialogue.sit: Well, 'cause they're nearly all paintings of you.

dialogue.t: Oh... It's okay, I don't mind. It sounds intriguing.
Oh, seems like Maalaus has decided what to draw! Quick, let's see what kind of paint we've got.
This time... Let's go for deep and tranquil colors!
Alright, these should do. What do you think, Maalaus?
Yep, looks like a happy kuuhenki to Paimon! Hehe, wonder what kind of painting we'll get this time...
Oh, is it done already?
Maalaus seems a little sad. Is it because of the painting? Let's take a look...
Okay so, it's Columbina... taking a walk under the moonlight and gazing up at the night sky.
Ah... I must be looking at the true moon beyond the false sky. I used to take midnight walks like that all the time.
Used to...? Oh, right...

dialogue.sit: (Columbina is pretty much confined to this garden, now... even though Nod-Krai is where she was born...)

dialogue.t: Yes, I would gaze at the sky and wonder... What really lies up there on the true Frost Moon?
Perhaps it's just like here, filled with lots of little animals...
Or perhaps... there's nothing there at all.
Oh...

dialogue.sit: You could always take a few up there with you?
There could be other cute creatures up there...

dialogue.t: Ha... An interesting thought.
But... Since the moon lies beyond the false sky, that's one adventure I would rather not risk taking them on...

dialogue.sit: (One is a "home" where she isn't even free to move around... the other is a "home" she knows nothing about...)

dialogue.t: Maalaus and the other kuuhenki are really gonna miss you...
And I will miss them too.
But in the end, this is a journey that only I can make... and the answer at the end of it is mine alone to seek.
And who knows? Whatever that answer turns out to be... Perhaps it will be something beautiful.
W—Well... We'll just have to come visit you, then! With Maalaus!
Alright. We could hold that art exhibition on the moon, perhaps.
Yeah, great idea! It's a promise!
Mm...
I hope so, I truly do...
What is there... up on the moon...

quests.description: The Damselette is having a spot of trouble in the Silvermoon Hall…
